philosophy: A - Parity: every Bullet Strike gun lives inside the vanilla/SW DPS-per-tile envelope (early 200-280, mid 300-400, late 300-380) and buys its edge with RANGE (220-250 / 300-340 / 500-600 m vs vanilla 190-260) plus deck mounting and immunity to power drain. The price is crew (1 to 8 per gun), command points and a moderate, consistent ammo economy (~750-900 hull damage per vanilla-bullet equivalent, the vanilla cannon anchor) built on one Magazine Press per ~1 mag/s. Defensive flak/CIWS are strong but deliberately ammo-hungry (2000 anti-shot pool per bullet vs vanilla flak 3000). Overclock gives +35-53% for heat; endgame power comes from stacking logistics and crew, never from out-of-band stats.

balance_checks: CONVENTIONS: fire_rate_shots_per_s = total sustained shells/s of the whole weapon (all barrels, at max spin for spin-up guns). dps_hull_std = rate x (direct + 0.5 x explosive pool) (explosive at 50% because armor resists 50% explosive and absorbs it). ammo_units_per_s = rate x resource_units_per_shot / shots_per_resource_unit. bullet_equivalent = recipe credit cost / 4 cr (std mag 6, AP 8.5, APHE 11, EMP 12.67, plasma cell 5, nuke shell 67.5, loose bullet 1). factories_needed_sustained = ammo_units_per_s / output rate of the gun's DIRECT factory (Magazine Press 1 mag/s, Plasma Condenser 1 cell/s, Nuke Foundry 0.5 shell/s, vanilla Cannon Ammo Factory 2 bullets/s for loose-bullet guns).

EARLY vs VANILLA: cannon_med 2x2 833 DPS (208/tile) 190 m, 1 crew, 2000 cr. BS 20mm 2x2 = 1050 DPS (262.5/tile) at 250 m, 1 crew, 2200 cr: +26% DPS/tile and +60 m, paid by 1.25 bullets/s (vs 1.11) and 1 crew per 4 tiles. LMG 1x1 = 260 DPS per crew (cannon_med 833/crew): counting ~1 tile of crew quarters per crew, LMG effective density ~130/tile vs cannon_med ~167/tile -> small BS guns trade crew for range, they do not obsolete the cannon.

MID vs VANILLA: 76mm 3x4 3900 DPS (325/tile, 1300/crew) at 340 m vs cannon_large 1778 DPS (198/tile, 889/crew) at 190 m and vs deck cannon 300/tile at 190 m. Minigun 2160 DPS max (360/tile, 1080/crew) at 310 m vs vanilla chaingun 18000 (1000/tile) at 240 m: BS minigun is 36% of chaingun per tile but has +70 m, deck mounting and a 4 s (not 10 s) spin-up; average over its first 4 s = 14 shots/s = 1260 DPS.

LATE vs VANILLA: 155mm 6400 DPS (320/tile, 1280/crew) at 520 m vs deck cannon 6000 DPS (300/tile, 1500/crew) at 190 m: +7% per tile, 2.7x range, but crew 5 vs 4, cost 28500 cr vs 20000 cr, turret 22 deg/s (deck 20), no infinite-penetration OC; shells take 2.3 s to reach 520 m so moving targets dodge. 406mm 13044 DPS (310.6/tile, 1630/crew) at 600 m costs 79000 cr, 8 crew, 16 CP and 15.7 bullets/s.

vs SW:ACD: SW 2x2 turbolasers 263-455/tile at 400 m (crew 2, power); SW faction 4x4 TLs 310-545/tile at 500 m (Bridge-locked). BS mid 325-380/tile at 300-340 m and late 310-320/tile at 500-600 m sit inside the SW envelope (below SW peaks, above SW heavy 4x4 family 69-111/tile). SW crewless 1x1 lasers (625/tile, 400 m) stay stronger than BS early guns (260/tile, 220-250 m).

RANGES: early 220/240/250 m; mid 300/310/320/340 m; late 500/520/550/600/600 m; defense 180 (light flak), 240 (CIWS), 320 (heavy flak), quad HMG 300. Overclocked maxima: 155mm 520x1.15 = 598 m, Heavy Plasma 550x1.0909 = 600 m; no base or OC range exceeds 600 m.

All BS defenses <= 1000/tile (cap 1500) and less ammo-efficient than vanilla flak = 'eats a lot of ammo'.

Heavy flak: heavy TL bolt 1 burst, SW missile 2-3 bursts. Beams (ion beam/prism, chaingun, SW mining) cannot be hit; OC fields attenuate only beams with AttenuationLimit.

DECK / PLACEMENT: every weapon is ProhibitedBy [tall] with a tall-layer ProhibitRects ring (0 for 1x1/1x2 so MGs pack edge to edge; 1 for 2x2-3x3; 2 for 76mm/4x4/4x5/5x6; 3 for the 406mm), no ProhibitAbove (can be surrounded by armor), IsHigh turret collider, IgnoreFriendlyShipLowLOSChecks, shots FriendlyShipLowCollisions = false; all uses_ammo + is_crewed, no battery storage (immune to ion/disruptor/EMP drains).

VERSION SAFETY: no always_crew_part toggle, no STRUCTURAL_DAMAGE_RETENTION globals (literals only), no CoverageSectorArc dependence, own literal shot speeds; ammo selector uses our own PartToggle 'bs_ammo_type' (modes 0 std, 1 ap, 2 aphe, 3 emp) added via AddMany; nuke limit via SW-style two-step CategoryLimits Add (OnlyIfNotExisting) + AddMany with category bs_limit_nuke.
